skill.summary: Extract structured invoice data (vendor, line items, totals, tax) from any invoice image. Pay $0.03 USDC via x402.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ntriq-x402-invoice-extract.
- Extracts structured data from invoice or receipt images, including vendor, line items, totals, and tax.
- Accepts image URL or base64; supports optional output language selection.
- No cloud upload or API key required—runs locally.
- Charges $0.03 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet.
